events.title: Passport forms and fees set for programme citizens
events.description: Passports (Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Forms and Fees) Regulations 2025 (SL 26 of 2025) set the passport application form, cancellation and loss notices, a separate register and a USD 500 fee for a new or renewed passport for people granted citizenship under the programme.

ledger.contains: Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Regulations 2024 (SL 28 of 2024, Gazette No. 453, 30 Oct 2024, 49 pp.; form pages 15-47 are images, read by OCR): eligibility and exclusions (police certificate for >6 months' residence in last 10 years; offences punishable by 12+ months; ICC, Interpol, terrorism, sanctions, high-risk-country citizens); approved due diligence firms, checks for 16+; agent licence (fee due 31 Jan, calendar-year licence, agent fee paid within 30 days of claim); application documents; 90-day verification; interviews 16+; dependants' affidavits (18+); Program Office -> Minister -> Registrar -> Cabinet; contribution and passport fees within 30 days of approval in principle; oath; certificate; post-approval additions; register access; Schedule 1 (contribution 105,000 / 110,000 / 115,000 / 15,000 per sibling; application fee 25,000 / 27,500 / 30,000; due diligence 10,000 / 7,500; passport 500), Schedule 2 (pre-approval additions: application 10,000, due diligence 7,500, passport 500, contribution to match family-size band), Schedule 3 (post-approval: contributions 25,000 spouse, 0 child up to 2 and recently adopted child, 20,000 child 3-18 and grandchild, 30,000 others; application fees 10,000 / 5,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 10,000 / 10,000; due diligence 7,500; passport 500), Schedule 4 (agent licence 5,000; agent fee 25,000); Schedules 5-8 forms: agent application (25% ownership disclosure), agent licence agreement and code of conduct (no advertising of agent fees, 30-day notice of sub-agents, no 'Nauru' in domain names), application information (fees non-refundable, contribution and passport fee paid on approval in principle), personal, financial and medical forms (10-year histories, five-year name-change bar), grant, oath, certificate and register templates. All amounts and numeric rules now recorded (eight terms were already there).

Passports (Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Forms and Fees) Regulations 2025 (SL 26 of 2025, Gazette No. 201, notified 19 May 2025, 13 pp.): passport application for programme citizens (certificate of citizenship, 2 photos, foreign passport bio-page), passport contents (serial 'NN' + 6 digits), cancellation and lost/stolen notices (incl. cancellation under s. 25 of the 2024 Act), photo rules (4.5 x 3.5 cm, 70-80% face, not older than 3 months), separate register, records kept indefinitely; Schedule 3 fees: new passport USD 500, renewal USD 500 (already recorded as one term). Added the gazettal as an event.
